title: Crispy German-Style Pan-Seared Mushrooms
description: A simple and flavorful recipe that showcases the perfect combination of crispy and savory.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in the skillet over medium-high heat.
Dredge the sliced mushrooms in the flour, shaking off excess.
Add the mushrooms to the skillet and sear for 2-3 minutes per side, or until golden brown.
Transfer the mushrooms to a plate and sprinkle with thyme.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil and heat until shimmering.
Add the pan-frying breadcrumbs to the skillet and cook, stirring constantly, until golden brown and crispy.
Season the breadcrumbs with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the crispy breadcrumbs over the pan-seared mushrooms.
Garnish with additional thyme, if desired.
